text:
Which statements about the metals zinc, magnesium, iron and sodium are correct?
1
They all conduct electricity.
2
They all have high melting points and boiling points.
3
They all form negative ions.
4
They all react with dilute acids to form hydrogen.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
